basic_info.description: Pacific Heights Full-Floor Cooperative with Breathtaking Views. Offered for the first time in 40 years, apartment 3 at 1940 Vallejo is a full-floor co-op spanning approx. 3,000 sq.ft. with sweeping, unobstructed views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Bay. Located in one of Pacific Heights' premier buildings, this grand 4BD/4BA home features elegant period details, high ceilings, hardwood floors, and a stately living room with fireplace. Includes 2-car parking. Kitchen, maids room, and 1 bathroom has been demolishedready for your custom vision.
